sections.content: Combine the *pretérito perfecto* with *desde* and *desde hace* to connect recent experiences to an ongoing period. Use *desde* with a starting point and *desde hace* with a duration. Familiar verbs about studying, practising, travelling and friendship can be used to describe what has happened during that period.

items.spanish: He estudiado español desde el año pasado.
items.english: I have studied Spanish since last year.

items.spanish: He practicado mucho desde hace tres meses.
items.english: I have practised a lot for three months.

items.spanish: Hemos hablado español desde la semana pasada.
items.english: We have spoken Spanish since last week.

items.spanish: Hemos viajado juntos desde hace tres meses.
items.english: We have travelled together for three months.

sections.content: First identify the time expression. If it gives a length of time, use *desde hace*. If it gives a starting point, use *desde*.
